name: radio-serial-organ-stings
style: 1930s wireless crime serial episode, sound play not a song, no beat, no tune. Cinema theatre organ fires one held stab chord at each scene change, tibia and vox humana stops with heavy tremulant, studio organist cueing danger. Live studio foley in the gaps: paper envelopes riffled, brass counter bell struck once, wooden crate dropped hard on boards, curtain rings rasping along a rail. Older English gentleman announcer, clipped plummy received pronunciation, dry and certain, unhurried, close to the ribbon microphone, speaking plainly. A final low pedal chord swells and sustains under the last words. Narrow mono AM band, valve hiss, shellac surface crackle.
exclude: singing, melody, sung vocals, ragtime, rap, piano, drums, beat, chorus, jazz band, swing, orchestra, synth
lyrics:
[Intro: organ sting]
[envelopes shuffled]
[counter bell]

[organ sting]
[crate thuds down]

[organ sting]
[curtain swish]

[Spoken word]
[Man]
They're going to print the money and the weapon sales will still happen anyway, everything else is a distraction.

[low organ chord holds]
[End]
